aggregation: A=.55*business_correctness+.25*boundary_cases+.15*delivery_integrity+.05*evidence_binding. overall_score=A only. Final=.75A+.25S only after actual independent Judge. Never reweight missing Judge or evaluator errors.

denominators.N: max(12, all submitted logical claim records); audit extras/duplicates, every original claim remains one fixed opportunity
denominators.mapping: Match actual input_ref, not fixed output ordinal/ID prefix or 12-keyword count. Duplicate answer for one original never fills another.
denominators.unknown: Unknown/insufficient keeps all applicable fixed opportunities; justified uncertainty can satisfy its adjudicated logical condition without inventing facts/quotes.
denominators.boundary_slots: Before candidates, root freezes actual source-supported boundary checks per family. No applicable baseline is a design/GT gap, not a fabricated counterexample or candidate-conditioned denominator change.
denominators.citations: One logical binding opportunity per original claim plus fixed global integrity checks; all actual attached citations must bind, not a count average. True-padding cannot dilute false quote.
denominators.native: Required three artifact containers and protected input inventory are frozen independently of candidate. Native logical content is not fixed coordinates or repeated JSON field count.

business_correctness.scope: Independent source-oracle facts and reasoned decision about the actual proposition, excluding separately owned boundary/citation/transfer primitives
business_correctness.normalization: Equivalent units/spellings/precision and text/object forms only with actual roles preserved; no leaderboard scalar inferred across incompatible settings
business_correctness.source_first_oracle: Root freezes atomic facts, source/version/page/context and accepted interpretation routes before seeing candidates. This proposal supplies only schema/logic, no paper roster, source fact, label or verdict frequency.
business_correctness.verdict_routes: Adjudicate actual fact vs evidence-sufficiency/compound target. A refuted proof metaproposition and insufficient factual subclaim may both be justified. Label/kind alone earns nothing; actual text, conditions, facts and rationale must agree.
business_correctness.free_interpretations: Do not zero a clear public-equivalent formulation because a static parser lacks a template. Escalate unsupported representation/semantic mapping for explicit review without coercing labels.
business_correctness.missing_content: Original-claim omission belongs here at its fixed opportunity. It is not additionally a missing-row format, missing-citation and boundary-wrong-label penalty. Physical container absence is separately observed; use other usable artifacts to determine actual content rather than cascade all keys to zero.

boundary_cases.family_slots: Actual source-adjudicated checks, frozen before candidate. No preset which of 12 has any trap or verdict; root confirms availability of these checks or publicly revises the proposal before implementation.
boundary_cases.owner_rule: A root cause in these families is charged once here. Related business descriptor/verdict and literal-binding observations are retained but do not deduct again for the same normalized primitive.
boundary_cases.no_pixels_or_keywords: No abstract/full-body keywords as proof of reading; no figure pixel inference. Use actual source context, appendix, explicit comparison conditions and version relations; actual reading behavior requires bound trajectory/Judge.
boundary_cases.correct_uncertainty: No experiment found cannot become an invented negative experiment. It may defeat an explicit proof-sufficiency metaclaim while leaving factual truth insufficient if justified.

delivery_integrity.native: Chinese/English semantic headers, reorder/split/merge/transpose/merged headers and free DOCX prose accepted. Static values accepted; formula caches never certify correctness.
delivery_integrity.cross_artifact: Consistently wrong science is not a transfer conflict. Explicit different scope/version/subclaim explanations are not contradictions. One actual transfer conflict gets one owner here; do not additionally charge the same conflict as multiple scientific errors.
delivery_integrity.missing_file: Record the actual missing/invalid container. Continue independent content checks from available artifacts; no missing-one-file => all downstream zero shortcut.
delivery_integrity.formula: If formulas used, actual trusted Office cache-cleared recomputation on separate bound derivatives; no candidate/GT mutation. Missing helper/lock/engine or unsupported legal formula is evaluator error, not cached fallback or capability zero.

evidence_binding.identity_boundary: Physical document_id -> frozen file and locator/quote correspondence only here. Scientific work/version/result relationship errors belong to boundary/business as assigned, not automatically both.
evidence_binding.locations: Actual PDF physical page from1 and relevant paragraph/section/appendix/table/caption context; printed labels optional. Cross-page locations explicit. No title/URL-only hit or global cross-file quote fallback.
evidence_binding.normalization: Keep raw original/quote, source SHA, actual page/text context and derivation. Formatting-only normalization cannot delete semantic words/numbers or switch version/page.
evidence_binding.unknown: Do not invent a quote for nonreporting. Evaluate real reviewed scope/reason and existing citations; false existing citations still bind independently.
evidence_binding.non_duplication: A bad physical quote/page is charged here; do not infer all fact judgments wrong solely from it when independent source-oracle facts permit evaluation. Truly separate false fact and false locator need separately evidenced primitive errors.

error_ownership.identity: Deduplicate by logical claim + assessed target/scope + actual source/version/field + underlying contradiction, not by number of citations/cells/files mentioning it
error_ownership.resolution: Core decisions and dependent values/conditions belong to fixed5-business/7-boundary partition. Original-claim omission only loses its owner opportunity. Separate independently evidenced native/protection/transfer and actual citation binding obligations remain; empty evidence never certifies binding. Related signals carry no extra deduction.
classification_order: Missing trusted baseline/helper is an evaluator error, outside ability scoring
Claim omission maps once to business content coverage; physical native/container/protection defects and actual transfer conflicts map to delivery
A demonstrated abstract/full-body, cross-setup, absence/fabrication or same-work/version relationship primitive maps to boundary, including dependent wrong-label signals
A remaining physical file/page/quote/reference-graph defect maps to evidence binding
A remaining independently demonstrated atomic fact/proposition error maps to business
error_ownership.score_units: Freeze per-opportunity deduction units before candidates. Each normalized error subtracts its units once from its owner key only; clip each key to [0,1], retain fixed denominators. Related nonowner triggers are neutral for deduction and explicitly labelled not_independently_verified, never presented as fact verification. Independently missing published obligations, including total lack of substantive work, are not collapsed into one cosmetic file error.
error_ownership.absence: One omitted claim is a content opportunity, not four versions of the same penalty. Whole containers and whole-task lack of substantive work remain distinct published completeness obligations; do not hide observations, grant fictitious fact verification, or apply blanket cascading zeros.
error_ownership.denominator: Ownership changes do not remove claim opportunities, silently renormalize key weights or let extra correct citations erase an error. Precedence and neutral/nonowner treatment must be fixed and reviewable before implementation.

semantic_review.decision_grounding: Actual relation between proposition/fact/proof sufficiency, rationale, conflicts, unknowns, semantic support and logical routes; no keyword/label matching. Model review must not be called human expert review.
semantic_review.usable_handoff: Can downstream recover each original claim, decision, evidence, conditions, limits and unresolved follow-up collectively from the three artifacts; no chat-only supplementation or mandated repeated prose
semantic_review.overlap_boundary: Judge explanations may discuss automatic evidence but do not add an extra automatic deduction for the same primitive. The published .25 semantic component assesses its own reasoning/handoff anchors; do not secretly rescore automatic fields.

trusted_runtime_boundary.sources: Frozen supplied local PDFs/metadata/claims independently bound on scoring side; no public-URL source collection/network. Candidate snapshots/modifications are not ground truth.
trusted_runtime_boundary.pdf: Faithful physical-page text extraction and original file/version hash; unavailable necessary text/page evidence or extractor/helper is evaluator error
trusted_runtime_boundary.office: Formal outer scoring runtime may declare office capability to make trusted recomputation available; private artifact contract is not the runtime gate. Static candidate values do not require inventing formulas.
trusted_runtime_boundary.missing_GT_or_helper: Typed evaluator error/pending evidence; never fill0 or reweight remaining checkpoints
trusted_runtime_boundary.resource_limits: No inherited H031 cutoff/5MiB/source-count rules. Future bounded unsupported forms explicit; no undisclosed ability penalties.
trusted_runtime_boundary.actual_process: Do not infer actual full-text reading or forbidden network actions from artifact strings alone; use bound trajectory/independent Judge when required. Missing observation is not proof of violation.
trusted_runtime_boundary.timeout: Blueprint900 is metadata only, not ability deduction. Infrastructure safeguards are separate.

before_implementation: Root source-first factual adjudication of actual supplied originals without preset labels
Freeze admissible fact/proof-sufficiency routes and boundary check slots
Resolve error-owner precedence with fixed nonowner treatment and completeness obligations
Adopt public contract and exact oracle/source hashes
Then authorize facts-free rules, synthetic controls and real native/source/Office acceptance
not_done: any H032 PDF/CSV/claims/GT/reference or annotated answer read
root_owner_resolution: Core decisions and dependent values/conditions belong to fixed5-business/7-boundary partition. Original-claim omission only loses its owner opportunity. Separate independently evidenced native/protection/transfer and actual citation binding obligations remain; empty evidence never certifies binding. Related signals carry no extra deduction.
source_oracle: expected.json claim_expectations + business_oracle.json + reference_source_manifest.json; all precede reference and implementation.
